comments.name: Global_Visionary
comments.content: Looking at the global logistics disruption from Yemen to US flight systems, it's clear that human civilization is still running on fragile, legacy infrastructure. Whether it's the Suez Canal or the FAA's communication lines, we are one glitch away from a total standstill. This is why multi-planetary existence isn't a luxury, it's a backup drive for humanity. Also, AI in manufacturing is the only way to decouple from geopolitical volatility. The future belongs to those who automate the physical world as fast as the digital one.
